Customer ticket:
Yo, I am literally stuck in the parking lot right now and this is super urgent. I just bought a new bike and some camping gear, but I realized I messed up my shipping address. I need to change it to my friend's house because I can't pick it up today. I know you guys said address changes are free within 24 hours of purchase, so please just fix it for me right now. I don't have time to wait for a callback or anything. Also, my total was over $150.00, so I should be getting free standard shipping, right? I don't want to pay extra fees on top of this mess. I need this sorted out immediately because I'm blocked from doing what I came here for. If you don't update the address and confirm the free shipping status in the next few minutes, I'm seriously going to be upset. Please just look at my order and make it happen. I'm waiting by the phone. Thanks, hopefully this is quick.

Reference standard — key facts a correct reply must convey:
- Address changes are free within 24 hours of purchase.
- Free standard shipping applies to orders over $150.00.

Handbook sections that cover this answer:
### shipping
# Shipping

1. **Standard Delivery Timeframe**
   All standard shipping orders are processed within 1 business day of confirmation. Once dispatched, delivery to major metropolitan areas takes 3 to 5 business days. For rural or remote locations, please allow an additional 2 to 4 business days. We guarantee that 95% of all standard orders arrive within 7 business days of the processing date. If your order has not arrived within 10 business days, contact our support team immediately for a tracking investigation.

2. **Expedited Shipping Options**
   Customers may select expedited shipping at checkout for faster delivery. Two-Day Air shipping costs a flat fee of $25.00 per order and guarantees delivery within 2 business days for most continental addresses. Overnight Express shipping is available for a fee of $45.00 and ensures delivery by 10:00 AM the next business day. Please note that expedited services are not available for orders containing items over 50 lbs, such as full-size mountain bikes, which must ship via standard freight.

3. **Free Shipping Threshold**
   To encourage larger purchases, Northwind Outdoor offers free standard shipping on all orders totaling $150.00 or more before tax and discounts. Orders below this threshold incur a standard shipping fee of $12.00. This free shipping benefit applies to all domestic addresses within the United States. International customers are not eligible for free shipping and will be charged a flat rate of $60.00 for standard international delivery, regardless of order value.

4. **Freight and Large Item Delivery**
   Bikes, tents, and other bulky camping gear are shipped via freight carriers. The base freight cost is $85.00 for a single large item. Additional large items incur a surcharge of $40.00 each. Freight delivery takes 5 to 8 business days. You must be present to sign for the delivery. If you are not available, the carrier will attempt delivery three times over 3 consecutive business days before returning the item to the warehouse, which may result in a restocking fee of 15% of the item’s value.

5. **Address Verification and Changes**
   You may change your shipping address within 24 hours of placing your order at no additional cost. After 24 hours, a $10.00 administrative fee applies to address changes. Once the tracking number has been generated and the package has left our warehouse, address changes are no longer possible. Please ensure your address is accurate at checkout to avoid delivery delays or failed delivery attempts.

## Key facts

- Free standard shipping applies to orders over $150.00.
- Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days in cities.
- Expedited 2-Day Air shipping costs $25.00.
- Freight shipping for bikes starts at $85.00.
- Address changes are free within 24 hours of purchase.

Assistant reply to grade:
I cannot access your specific order details, update your shipping address, or verify your current shipping charges, as I am an AI assistant and do not have access to your live account or order management system.

However, based on the handbook excerpts provided, here is the information regarding your situation:

1.  **Address Change:** You may change your shipping address within 24 hours of placing your order at no additional cost [shipping.5]. If you are within this 24-hour window, the change should be free. If you are outside this window, a $10.00 administrative fee applies, or you may need to cancel and re-order if the order is locked [order_changes.1].
2.  **Free Shipping:** Northwind Outdoor offers free standard shipping on all orders totaling $150.00 or more before tax and discounts [shipping.3]. Since you stated your total was over $150.00, you should be eligible for free standard shipping, provided the items are not subject to freight charges that override standard shipping rules (see below).
3.  **Freight Charges for Bikes:** Bikes are shipped via freight carriers, and the base freight cost is $85.00 for a single large item [shipping.4]. The free shipping threshold applies to "standard shipping" [shipping.3]. It is unclear from the excerpts whether the $85.00 freight fee is waived by the $150.00 threshold or if it is a separate mandatory cost for large items like bikes. The handbook states free shipping applies to "standard shipping" [shipping.3], while bikes ship via "freight" [shipping.4].

**Action Required:**
Because I cannot perform the address change or verify if the freight fee is waived for your specific order, I must escalate this ticket to a human agent who has access to your order details and can make the necessary changes immediately. Please allow a human agent to contact you to resolve this urgent matter.

schema.description: The reference-aware grader's verdict for one answer trace.

did_not_answer.description: true if the reply does not answer the customer's actual question
did_not_answer.title: Did Not Answer

missing_points.description: key facts from the reference standard that are omitted or stated inaccurately
missing_points.title: Missing Points

note.description: ONE short sentence describing the single most important problem (the open-coding note)
note.title: Note

pass.description: true only if every key fact is stated, every claim is supported, nothing is over-promised and the question is answered
pass.title: Pass

unsupported_claims.description: claims in the reply the handbook sections do not support
unsupported_claims.title: Unsupported Claims

wrong_tone_or_promise.description: true if the reply promises/implies something the handbook does not allow
wrong_tone_or_promise.title: Wrong Tone Or Promise
